facts.text: BipedEnvV2 is the MuJoCo V2 environment class
MujocoV2-v0 is registered with entry_point envs.mujoco.biped_env_v2:BipedEnvV2 and max_episode_steps=1000
BaseEnv, the base class of BipedEnvV2, extends gymnasium.Env
BaseEnv loads the MuJoCo model with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path
The default V2 model path is envs/assets/robotV2/robot_v2.xml
The action space is Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(12,)): twelve normalized joint targets
The observation space is a Dict of an actor Box and a critic Box
The actor observation has 50 values and the privileged critic observation 60 values
The actor observation is lin_acc_b(3), ang_vel_b(3), projected_gravity(3), commands(3), joint_pos_rel(12), joint_vel(12), prev_actions(12) and gait_phase(2)
The critic observation is the 50-value actor observation plus base_lin_vel_b(3), height(1) and feet_forces(6)
The physics step is 0.005 s at 200 Hz, decimation is 4 and the control step is 0.02 s at 50 Hz
reset reseeds numpy's generator when a seed is given and resets the MuJoCo data
reset returns the observation and an empty info dict
step clips each action to the [-1, 1] range before applying it
step returns the five-tuple (observation, reward, terminated, False, {}) and never truncates itself
The episode terminates when the torso tilt exceeds 0.784 rad or both feet have been airborne for more than 1/STEP_DT steps
The environment metadata declares human and rgb_array render modes at 50 fps

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds numpy's generator upstream and random.Random in this package's fake; the dynamics are deterministic when the same implementation is given the same seed and actions, but the two generators produce different trajectories for one seed

gaps: the fake backend is a pure Python kinematic stand-in: it does not run MuJoCo, the BAM servo and backlash model, contacts, friction, the shared reward terms or the 50 Hz decimation loop
the fake draws its start state with Python's random.Random; upstream seeds numpy's generator (envs/mujoco/biped_env_v2.py:693-694), so one seed gives different trajectories on the two
the fake returns Python lists of placeholder values with the upstream observation lengths (50 actor values, 60 critic values); upstream returns numpy float32 arrays with the real sensor semantics
no rendering, no get_state/set_state: snapshot_restore is false
the fake applies the registered MujocoV2-v0 1000-step TimeLimit itself; the upstream class's step never truncates (envs/mujoco/biped_env_v2.py:773)
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
